item.title: The joint gluing inequality in the language of Green's functions
item.description: A short expository note retelling OpenAI's proof of the joint gluing inequality with two Green functions: the hitting matrix is the Green matrix of a killed relay chain, and its positivity comes from one Poisson equation.
